scope.semantics: finite typed realizations unless a row narrows the scope
scope.domain_identity: equivalence class of the symmetric semantics-preserving reduction preorder under an accepted burden class

accepted_burden_equivalence_classes.semantic_requirement: bidirectional exact equality of protected developmental response on every registered ecology/intervention
accepted_burden_equivalence_classes.overhead_requirement: every registered lifecycle coordinate is equal after declared unit conversion
accepted_burden_equivalence_classes.boundary: Does not identify unregistered physical or precision costs.

accepted_burden_equivalence_classes.semantic_requirement: bidirectional exact equality of protected developmental response on every registered ecology/intervention
accepted_burden_equivalence_classes.overhead_requirement: each nonzero lifecycle coordinate is bounded by a prospectively declared finite multiplicative constant plus finite setup constant in both directions
accepted_burden_equivalence_classes.boundary: Constants and size coordinate must be frozen; zero denominators require additive bounds rather than ratios.

accepted_burden_equivalence_classes.semantic_requirement: bidirectional exact equality of protected developmental response on every registered ecology/intervention
accepted_burden_equivalence_classes.overhead_requirement: for one frozen native size vector, every lifecycle coordinate has an explicit polynomial upper bound in both directions
accepted_burden_equivalence_classes.boundary: Degree, coefficients, precision, horizon and encoding are part of the claim; one-way simulation establishes only preorder.

accepted_burden_equivalence_classes.semantic_requirement: approximate/statistical response agreement under a declared metric or test distribution
accepted_burden_equivalence_classes.overhead_requirement: measured or bounded burden with explicit uncertainty
accepted_burden_equivalence_classes.boundary: Useful evidence, but insufficient for exact structural-domain equivalence.

domains.name: coefficient_function_field
domains.definition: Sufficient cognitive state is primarily a finite coefficient/parameter object defining a map or dynamical operator.

carriers.mathematical_object: finite typed tensor/vector theta over a declared scalar field or finite precision set
carriers.semantic_state: the input-output or transition law induced by theta and the fixed interpreter/basis
carriers.equivalence: equal protected evaluations and update responses over the registered ecology, not raw coefficient equality
carriers.serialization: shape, scalar representation, basis identifier, coefficient sequence

native_operators.signature: Theta x Evidence x Verifier -> Theta
native_operators.semantics: replace coefficient state according to admitted evidence

domains.falsifier: an asserted D1 realization whose protected response depends on state absent from the declared coefficient object/interpreter

domains.name: exemplar_memory_indexed
domains.definition: Sufficient cognitive state is primarily retained cases, records, exemplars, or associative traces.

carriers.mathematical_object: finite multiset or key-value relation over typed records
carriers.semantic_state: query-relevant distinctions retained by records plus index semantics
carriers.equivalence: equal retrieval fibers and protected responses under the registered update/query sequence
carriers.serialization: record schema, records, multiplicities/keys, index contract

native_operators.semantics: return records admitted by the query relation

native_operators.signature: Records x Record x Action -> Records

domains.falsifier: a D2 classification whose obligation-sufficient state is unchanged when every retained record/index distinction is erased

domains.name: probabilistic_belief
domains.definition: Sufficient cognitive state is an explicit probability law, posterior, or uncertainty-bearing latent structure.

carriers.mathematical_object: normalized or explicitly subnormalized measure over a declared hypothesis/latent space
carriers.semantic_state: probabilities assigned to protected events and decisions under declared loss
carriers.equivalence: almost-sure or support-object equality under the declared observation class and query set
carriers.serialization: space, measure representation, normalization/failure convention, precision

native_operators.semantics: marginalize, condition, sample, or decide under belief
update belief by the declared conditioning rule

domains.falsifier: a purported D3 state whose protected uncertainty/decision behavior is not determined by the declared measure and interpreter

domains.name: symbolic_rule_program
domains.definition: Sufficient cognitive state is discrete compositional syntax: rules, programs, proofs, equations, or constraints.

carriers.mathematical_object: finite typed term, rule set, proof object, or syntax graph
carriers.semantic_state: meaning induced by the declared interpreter/rewrite relation
carriers.equivalence: equal protected semantics and developmental rewrite response, not textual identity
carriers.serialization: signature, typed syntax graph, rule ordering, interpreter/version

native_operators.semantics: apply one legal evaluation or rewrite step
construct a typed composite with declared semantics

verifier_access: type checker, interpreter, proof or task verifier

domains.falsifier: a D4 classification without a declared compositional syntax and operational semantics

domains.name: search_deliberative_frontier
domains.definition: Sufficient cognitive state includes an evolving frontier of candidate futures, solutions, and verifier results.

carriers.mathematical_object: finite queue/multiset of candidates with traces, priorities, and verification state
carriers.semantic_state: reachable candidate set plus selection/expansion history still relevant to future discovery
carriers.equivalence: equal future verified discovery distribution/burden under the registered proposal and selection law
carriers.serialization: candidate encoding, queue order, scores, traces, verifier receipts

native_operators.signature: Frontier x ProposalLaw x Score -> Frontier

native_operators.semantics: return a verified candidate or refuse

domains.falsifier: a D5 claim whose future discovery behavior is independent of the declared frontier/proposal state

domains.name: dynamical_state_controller
domains.definition: Sufficient cognitive state is a temporal state whose iterated evolution is constitutive of computation.

carriers.mathematical_object: typed state z in a finite, discrete, continuous, or hybrid state space with transition law F
carriers.semantic_state: current state plus transition/readout law determining protected trajectories
carriers.equivalence: bisimulation or protected trace equivalence under registered interventions/horizon
carriers.serialization: state-space type, current state, transition/readout law, clock/reset convention

native_operators.semantics: emit protected observation from current state

domains.falsifier: a D6 claim where deleting current temporal state leaves every protected future trace unchanged

domains.name: collective_distributed_population
domains.definition: Sufficient cognitive state depends on component states plus their interaction topology/messages and is not localized to one component.

carriers.mathematical_object: indexed family of component states plus typed communication topology and in-flight messages
carriers.semantic_state: joint configuration distinctions required for protected collective response
carriers.equivalence: protected distributed-trace equivalence under scheduler, failures, and communication contract
carriers.serialization: component states, topology, message queues, scheduler/failure semantics

native_operators.semantics: change component membership or interaction topology

domains.falsifier: a D7 classification whose protected response admits an equivalent single-component carrier within the accepted burden class

domains.name: morphogenetic_self_rewriting
domains.definition: Architecture, representation family, or update law is itself mutable obligation-relevant cognitive state.

carriers.mathematical_object: typed morphology/genotype descriptor plus installed components, interfaces, and developmental law
carriers.semantic_state: current and reachable future realizations under the registered morphogenesis grammar
carriers.equivalence: equal protected present response and future morphology/capability reachability with matched burden
carriers.serialization: typed component graph, interface contracts, mutable rules, installed state, rollback point

native_operators.signature: Morphology x Address x Component -> Morphology
native_operators.semantics: replace one installed component or law and migrate state

native_operators.signature: Genotype x Ecology x Resources -> Realization
native_operators.semantics: construct and install a serving realization

verifier_access: proposal, regression, safety, and task verifiers

domains.falsifier: a D8 claim where morphology/update-law changes can be erased without changing any protected future reachability or burden

global_falsifier: a registry row missing its sufficient-state carrier, native execution semantics, development law, strongest parent, burden coordinates, or explicit claim ceiling
